matrix.name: direct_steady
matrix.action: Child PATH DIRECT; collect >=3 canonical frames
matrix.expect: single active direct path; one HA device

matrix.name: direct_to_relay
matrix.action: Child PATH RELAY; authenticated Probe then >=3 frames
matrix.expect: lease switches only after stability; no duplicate canonical

matrix.name: relay_to_direct
matrix.expect: lease returns to direct; bounded old grace

matrix.name: duplicate
matrix.expect: same tuple is duplicate; canonical unchanged

matrix.name: reorder
matrix.expect: reassembly deterministic; at most one canonical

matrix.name: late_old_frame
matrix.action: advance canonical then Child RESEND old frame
matrix.expect: old frame cannot roll canonical back

matrix.name: child_restart
matrix.expect: new persisted boot session; no nonce reuse

matrix.name: authorization_revoke
matrix.expect: Relay ingress fail closed and Relay lease invalidated

matrix.name: authorization_regrant
matrix.expect: Relay must re-enter through normal stability path

matrix.name: key_rotation
matrix.expect: epoch2 accepted; canonical continuous; epoch1 grace semantics observable

matrix.name: broker_outage
matrix.action: stop isolated broker, wait through retry window, restore broker
matrix.expect: no false positive ReceiptAck; bounded retry; recovery without duplicate canonical

matrix.name: identity_continuity
matrix.action: compare HA device/entity registries before/after all path switches
matrix.expect: same NODE_ID maps to one device; no duplicate Discovery
